content:
zoe: Drafting 0.10.0 release notes. Need a quick sweep on SDK snippets and a short migration note for batch embeddings.
sam: Happy to check JS samples. I already spotted `client.embeddingsStream` used in two places.
ian: I'll run link-checker. Noticed /guides/old-cache still referenced in changelog.
harper: I'll draft the known-issues line for Dedicated: "intermittent 503s during scale-up; mitigation: enable burst capacity or set canary fallback to hosted." Keep short.
sam: JS fix idea:
```js
// old
await client.embeddingsStream('text')
// new
await client.embeddings.batch({ inputs: ['text'] })
```
zoe: Nice. Add a token-accounting note: batched embeddings may change token estimates.
ian: Link fixes pushed in #4721.
docs-bot: Run snippet-lint and include migration anchor at /docs/migration/0.10.0/embed-batch.
zoe: Plan: merge snippet & link PRs, then update changelog draft and ping product. Target publish window tomorrow.
release-bot: Draft changelog: https://git.redwood-inference/release/0.10.0/changelog-draft.md
zoe: Thanks all ":thumbsup:"
